note: Release candidate 1. Every rule now carries a non-null value for all twelve required fields. exceptionEligibleNote remains an additional, supplemental field beyond the twelve required properties and may be null. See CHANGELOG-RC1.md for every field changed from the prior packet, its previous value, its new value, the reason, and whether the change was mechanical normalization or a product-policy correction.

rules.expectedBehavior: A non-empty webinar title is present
rules.failureMessage: "Webinar title is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter a title before proceeding.

rules.failureMessage: "A topic or description is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add a short description of the session content.

rules.expectedBehavior: Objective field selected from governed objective values
rules.failureMessage: "A business objective is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Select the objective this webinar supports.

rules.failureMessage: "An intended audience is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Select or define the target audience.

rules.expectedBehavior: Valid future or same-day date present
rules.failureMessage: "Event date is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter the event date.

rules.failureMessage: "Start time is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter the event start time.

rules.failureMessage: "Event duration is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter the expected duration in minutes.

rules.failureMessage: "Time zone is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Select the event's time zone.

rules.expectedBehavior: One of live, hybrid, simulated live, on-demand selected
rules.failureMessage: "Event format is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Select the delivery format.

rules.failureMessage: "Event platform or location is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter the delivery platform or venue.

rules.failureMessage: "A registration destination is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach an approved registration page.

rules.expectedBehavior: At least one speaker record marked confirmed
rules.failureMessage: "At least one confirmed speaker is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm a speaker before proceeding to recruitment.

rules.failureMessage: "An activity owner is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Assign an owner.

rules.failureMessage: "A recruitment owner is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Assign a recruitment owner.

rules.failureMessage: "A follow-up owner is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Assign a follow-up owner.

rules.failureMessage: "A primary CTA is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Define the primary call to action.

rules.failureMessage: "A follow-up CTA is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Define the follow-up call to action.

rules.expectedBehavior: At least one measurement target selected
rules.failureMessage: "A measurement plan is required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Select the metrics this webinar will be measured against.

rules.expectedBehavior: Recording availability stated, including "not expected" as a valid value
rules.failureMessage: "Recording availability must be stated."
rules.resolutionGuidance: State whether a recording will be available and, if so, when.

rules.failureMessage: "Registration opening and closing rules are required."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Define when registration opens and closes.

rules.failureMessage: "Capacity is required for this platform."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Enter the platform's capacity limit.

rules.failureMessage: "Waitlist handling must be stated when capacity is set."
rules.resolutionGuidance: State whether a waitlist will be used and how it will be managed.

rules.failureMessage: "A handraiser CTA is expected for this objective."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add a handraiser CTA or document why the objective does not require one.

rules.trigger: Campaign channel mix includes paid or organic support
rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Document supporting channels if used.

rules.failureMessage: "Language must be set for this audience."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Set the content language.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Document accessibility accommodations.

rules.failureMessage: "Consent or preference language is required for this audience."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach the required consent language.

rules.failureMessage: "A sales follow-up rule is required for this objective."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Define the handoff rule to sales.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking; omission logged.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Full window applies; no action needed.

rules.expectedBehavior: Communication scheduled 14 days before event or as adjusted
rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: See shortened-window table if omitted.

rules.expectedBehavior: Communication scheduled 7 days before event or as adjusted
rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: See shortened-window table if omitted.

rules.trigger: The 1-day recruitment communication is applicable under the selected recruitment-window band
rules.expectedBehavior: The communication is configured when applicable; omission is permitted only when the approved shortened-window logic makes it inapplicable
rules.exceptionEligibleNote: when a valid shortened-window omission applies
rules.failureMessage: "A final recruitment communication could not be scheduled in the future."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Adjust the event date or accept the compressed-window warning.

rules.expectedBehavior: Person removed from all remaining recruitment sends
rules.failureMessage: "A registered person would still receive a recruitment communication."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Fix suppression logic before send.

rules.trigger: Person is opted out or otherwise ineligible
rules.failureMessage: "An ineligible recipient is included in the recruitment list."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove the recipient before send.

rules.failureMessage: "A cancelled registrant is included in the recruitment list."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove the recipient before send.

rules.failureMessage: "An internal or test record is included in the recruitment list."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove or correctly label the record.

rules.failureMessage: "A known-invalid address is included in the recruitment list."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove or correct the address.

rules.failureMessage: "A governed campaign exclusion is not applied."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Apply the campaign's exclusion rule before send.

rules.expectedBehavior: Send time is not in the past at send
rules.failureMessage: "This communication would send in the past."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Recompute using the shortened-window logic.

rules.failureMessage: "Registration confirmation failed to send."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Investigate delivery failure before relying on registration count.

rules.failureMessage: "Calendar and attendance information was not delivered."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach calendar details to the confirmation template.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking; omission logged.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm reminder scheduling if omitted.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking; omission logged.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm reminder scheduling if omitted.

rules.failureMessage: "A material change was not communicated to registrants."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Trigger the change notification before proceeding.

rules.failureMessage: "Event cancellation was not communicated to registrants."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Trigger the cancellation notification.

rules.expectedBehavior: Time zone displayed alongside every time
rules.failureMessage: "An event time is displayed without its time zone."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add time zone display to the template.

rules.trigger: Registration occurs after a scheduled reminder
rules.expectedBehavior: Registrant receives confirmation and all remaining future reminders only
rules.failureMessage: "A late registrant would receive a backdated reminder."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Recompute the registrant's reminder set at registration time.

rules.failureMessage: "Attended follow-up was not sent within 1 business day."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the follow-up or record an exception with reason.

rules.failureMessage: "Attended follow-up is missing a thank-you message."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add the required content.

rules.failureMessage: "Recording is available but not included in the follow-up."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach the recording.

rules.failureMessage: "Attended follow-up is missing a next-best-action CTA."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add the appropriate CTA.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add if the objective calls for it.

rules.expectedBehavior: Sent within 1 business day after attendance data available
rules.failureMessage: "Absent follow-up was not sent within 1 business day of attendance data."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the follow-up or record an exception.

rules.failureMessage: "Absent follow-up does not acknowledge non-attendance."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Correct the message content.

rules.failureMessage: "Recording is available but not included in the absent follow-up."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach the recording.

rules.failureMessage: "Absent follow-up is missing a next-best-action."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add the appropriate CTA.

rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Add if appropriate.

rules.expectedBehavior: Reconciliation attempted before sending either attended or absent message
rules.failureMessage: "Attendance was not reconciled before follow-up."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Reconcile attendance data before sending.

rules.expectedBehavior: Only one of attended/absent variant sent per person
rules.failureMessage: "Conflicting attended and absent messages were sent to the same person."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Correct the send list and issue a single corrected message if needed.

rules.expectedBehavior: Neutral variant sent or exception recorded
rules.failureMessage: "Attendance remains unresolved beyond 2 business days with no action taken."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the neutral variant or record an exception.

rules.failureMessage: "Waitlist confirmation was not sent."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the confirmation.

rules.failureMessage: "A promoted waitlist registrant was not notified."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the promotion confirmation.

rules.failureMessage: "A non-admitted waitlist registrant was not notified."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the closure notification.

rules.expectedBehavior: Waitlist state visible in the plan even if managed manually
rules.failureMessage: "Waitlist is in use but not represented in the plan."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Record waitlist status in the campaign package.

rules.failureMessage: "Cancellation confirmation was not sent."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Send the confirmation.

rules.expectedBehavior: No further reminders or follow-ups unless policy permits
rules.failureMessage: "A cancelled registrant would still receive a future communication."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Fix suppression logic.

rules.expectedBehavior: Excluded from recruitment, attendance, follow-up, and reporting
rules.failureMessage: "An internal or test record is included in reporting or communications."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Exclude the record.

rules.expectedBehavior: Send permitted if explicitly labeled test
rules.failureMessage: Not blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Label the send as test before dispatch.

rules.trigger: Attended and absent follow-up both configured
rules.expectedBehavior: Different message variants used, shared destination allowed
rules.failureMessage: "Attended and absent follow-up use identical message content."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Differentiate the two variants.

rules.failureMessage: The full 21, 14, 7, and 1-day recruitment sequence was not produced for a webinar with 21 or more days remaining at creation.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Generate all four recruitment communications at 21, 14, 7, and 1 day before the event.

rules.expectedBehavior: Immediate launch communication, then 7- and 1-day communications
rules.failureMessage: The 14-to-20-day band's immediate-launch, 7-day, and 1-day communication set was not produced.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Generate an immediate launch communication and the 7- and 1-day recruitment communications; do not schedule the 21-day communication, since it cannot occur in the future.

rules.failureMessage: The 7-to-13-day band's immediate-launch and 1-day communication set was not produced.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Generate an immediate launch communication and the 1-day recruitment communication only.

rules.expectedBehavior: Immediate launch and 1-day communications if separable by 24+ hours; otherwise immediate only
rules.failureMessage: The 2-to-6-day band's immediate-launch communication, and its 1-day communication where separable by at least 24 hours, was not produced correctly.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Generate an immediate launch communication; add the 1-day communication only if it can be scheduled at least 24 hours after the immediate launch, otherwise send the immediate launch alone.

rules.trigger: Less than 2 days remaining, event not started
rules.expectedBehavior: Immediate launch communication with compressed-window warning
rules.failureMessage: The under-2-days band's immediate-launch communication with a compressed-window warning was not produced.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Generate the immediate-launch communication only, and display a compressed-window warning to the marketer.

rules.failureMessage: A recruitment communication was scheduled for an event that has already started or completed.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove the scheduled recruitment communication; no recruitment touch may be created once the event has started.

rules.failureMessage: One or more required setup fields in section A are incomplete.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete every required setup field before recruitment can begin.

rules.failureMessage: The registration flow has not been tested end to end.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Run the registration flow test; this rule cannot be bypassed by exception.

rules.expectedBehavior: WEB-SETUP-011 passed and destination is a tested, approved page
rules.failureMessage: The registration destination is missing or has not been validated as a tested, approved page.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Attach and validate an approved registration destination.

rules.failureMessage: The immediate registration confirmation communication is not configured.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Configure the registration confirmation communication.

rules.expectedBehavior: Correct band from Section F applied
rules.failureMessage: The recruitment communication set required by the applicable shortened-window band has not been configured.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Configure the communications required by the current band; see the shortened-window rules for the exact set.

rules.expectedBehavior: All Section C suppression rules active
rules.failureMessage: One or more recruitment suppression rules are not active.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Activate all required suppression rules before recruitment can begin.

rules.failureMessage: The activity owner, recruitment owner, or follow-up owner is not assigned.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Assign all three required owners.

rules.expectedBehavior: Governed internal name, campaign code, taxonomy values, and applicable UTMs are available and verified
rules.failureMessage: Governed internal name, campaign code, taxonomy values, or applicable UTMs are missing or unverified.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Connect and verify the governed naming, taxonomy, and UTM source before proceeding; this is a required blocker, not a bypassable dependency.

rules.failureMessage: The join link or venue has not been tested.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Test the join link or venue; this rule cannot be bypassed by exception.

rules.failureMessage: No speaker has been confirmed for this webinar.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm at least one speaker.

rules.failureMessage: The event brief or run-of-show is missing or incomplete.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete the event brief or run-of-show.

rules.failureMessage: Supporting content has not been confirmed ready.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm supporting content is ready.

rules.failureMessage: The 24-hour or 1-hour registrant reminder is not configured or validly omitted.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Configure the registrant reminders, or confirm their omission is valid under the approved cadence.

rules.expectedBehavior: Capture mechanism tested, or its absence documented
rules.failureMessage: The attendance capture mechanism has not been tested, and its absence has not been documented.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Test the attendance capture mechanism, or document why it is unavailable for this session.

rules.failureMessage: Attendance has not been reconciled and its unresolved status has not been documented.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Reconcile attendance, or record the unresolved state as required by the attendance-unknown rules.

rules.expectedBehavior: All applicable Section E rules for the actual audience-state mix pass
rules.failureMessage: One or more required follow-up communications for the actual audience-state mix have not been completed.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete every required follow-up communication for each audience state present in this webinar.

rules.expectedBehavior: Every exception used anywhere in the activity has a complete record
rules.failureMessage: An exception was used but its record is incomplete.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete the exception record before this webinar can be marked complete.

rules.failureMessage: The measurement targets defined in setup have not been recorded.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Record the measurement results against the plan defined in setup.

rules.expectedBehavior: At least one speaker is confirmed and has received necessary materials
rules.failureMessage: Speaker readiness has not been confirmed.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm speaker readiness, including receipt of necessary materials.

rules.expectedBehavior: The event brief or run-of-show is confirmed ready
rules.failureMessage: Content or run-of-show readiness has not been confirmed.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Confirm the event brief or run-of-show is ready.

rules.ruleName: Registration flow tested end to end
rules.expectedBehavior: The registration flow has been tested end to end and confirmed working
rules.failureMessage: The registration flow has not been tested end to end.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Test the registration flow end to end; this rule cannot be bypassed by exception.

rules.expectedBehavior: The join link or venue has been tested and confirmed working
rules.failureMessage: The join link or venue has not been tested.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Test the join link or venue; this rule cannot be bypassed by exception.

rules.expectedBehavior: Governed UTM output is generated from the authoritative governance source for every applicable communication
rules.failureMessage: Governed UTM output has not been generated from the authoritative governance source for one or more applicable communications.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Connect to the governance source and generate governed UTM output for every applicable communication before proceeding.

rules.ruleName: Standardized internal title generated, not typed
rules.expectedBehavior: The internal title is generated from governed values, not typed manually
rules.failureMessage: The internal title was typed manually rather than generated from governed values.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Regenerate the internal title from the governed naming source.

rules.expectedBehavior: Waitlist status, if in use, is visibly represented in the plan
rules.failureMessage: Waitlist is in use but not represented in the plan.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Record waitlist status and management approach in the plan.

rules.expectedBehavior: Both the recruitment owner and the follow-up owner are named
rules.failureMessage: The recruitment owner or the follow-up owner is not named.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Name both the recruitment owner and the follow-up owner.

rules.expectedBehavior: All applicable QA checks are confirmed before the event
rules.failureMessage: Final QA has not been confirmed before the event.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete and confirm all applicable QA checks before the event.

rules.expectedBehavior: The measurement plan and its targets are defined and present
rules.failureMessage: The measurement plan or its targets are not defined.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Define the measurement plan and its targets before recruitment begins.

rules.expectedBehavior: Every exception used anywhere in the activity has a complete and valid record; an incomplete exception never satisfies the rule it was invoked against, and that rule's original blocker remains active at its originating readiness stage until the exception record is complete and valid
rules.exceptionEligibleNote: this rule governs the exception mechanism itself
rules.failureMessage: One or more exceptions used in this activity have an incomplete or invalid record, so the rule they were invoked against remains blocking.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Complete the exception record fully, or resolve the original blocker directly; this rule itself cannot be satisfied through an exception.

rules.expectedBehavior: Every applicable rule across all readiness stages has passed or been resolved through a valid, complete exception where exception-eligible
rules.failureMessage: One or more completion criteria across the readiness stages have not been satisfied.
rules.resolutionGuidance: Resolve every remaining blocker or complete every required exception before the webinar can be marked complete.

rules.trigger: A standard communication was omitted under bands WEB-WIN-002 through WEB-WIN-006
rules.expectedBehavior: The omission is visibly listed as omitted-because-past-due, not silently absent
rules.failureMessage: "Omitted communications are not displayed to the user."
rules.resolutionGuidance: Surface the omission list in the activity view.
